Madam
I am obliged by your MS, but Alexandrine des Escherolles has been already translated. [^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Private Trials and Public Calamities or, The early life of Alexandrine des Écherolles, during the troubles of the first French revolution 2 vols (London: Bentley 1853), a translation by Anne Percy of Alexandrine des Écherolles, Quelques années de ma vie (Moulins 1843).
